1 star is actually still too much.

We had our cat sterilized here. However, after the procedure, she continued to show clear signs of being in heat. We returned to the veterinary clinic several times for this and also showed footage of her behavior: continuous loud meowing, extreme affection, rolling and wriggling on the ground, spraying, and clear signs of restlessness. Each episode lasted about 5-7 days, after which she exhibited normal behavior again for about 2 weeks (classic heat, if you ask us).

Despite these symptoms and the footage, it was indicated that it could not be heat, since our cat had been sterilized after all. At our insistence, a blood test was eventually performed to check if there was indeed hormonal activity and thus heat. We were subsequently called with the message that the test was negative, our cat no longer had a cycle, and therefore there could absolutely be no question of heat. However, when we inquired about exactly which test had been performed, it turned out that the wrong test had been done, meaning it could not be concluded at all that the cat was no longer in heat. When we pointed this out in a normal manner at the reception desk, we were yelled at in a crowded practice. Among other things, they shouted that our cat had a behavioral disorder and asked how we dared even suggest that the surgery performed by Hank, given his experience, had not been performed lege artis.

Because our cat continued to exhibit heat behavior, we eventually went to another veterinarian. There, the correct blood test was performed, and lo and behold: it was a resounding positive, indicating the continued presence of functional ovarian tissue.

Furthermore, because our cat continued to spray urine all over the house, we decided, in consultation with our new veterinarian, to perform a re-operation in the hope of discovering how this is possible after sterilization. And as it turned out: only one ovary had been removed, and the other ovary was still present in its entirety in the abdomen. Our new veterinarian also couldn't understand how one could remove just one ovary during a sterilization. It is possible that the ovary was accidentally dropped into the abdomen during the operation and started producing hormones again, or perhaps he simply forgot.

We subsequently reported this back to Stadion Dierenkliniek. At that time, too, they indicated that, in their opinion, this was not possible, that our cat supposedly had a behavioral problem, and that we should stop nagging about it.

At the request of Stadion Dierenkliniek, the tissue removed during the reoperation was eventually sent to the pathologist to examine what kind of tissue it was, because they did not believe it could be an ovary. The result was clear: it involved an entire ovary...

After much contact and effort, we eventually received reimbursement for the costs of the reoperation. However, what we have not received to date is an apology for the situation, the way our concerns were handled, and all the complications and consequences of the first failed operation.

Complications can, of course, occur; surgery remains human work. However, what weighed particularly heavily on us is that our repeated concerns and the demonstrable signs of being in heat were dismissed multiple times, and we were declared crazy, even though it turned out afterwards that an entire ovary was indeed still present, and we never received even the slightest apology for this. Judging by the reviews I read, the veterinary clinic will likely come up with a completely different story, claiming that everything I say is nonsense and that it didn't happen that way at all. But as far as we are concerned, that fits perfectly with how we were treated here and how the complications were handled.

Based on our own experience, we would therefore absolutely not recommend this veterinary clinic.

I honestly wish Google allowed me to give more than five stars to Stadiondierenkliniek.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️Exceptional care, professionalism and genuine compassion

I called because my cat was having serious problems with his bladder. Despite their busy schedule, the team immediately understood the urgency and told me to bring him in right away. From the moment we arrived, the level of professionalism, care and attention was exceptional.

They didn’t simply treat the immediate problem and send us home. They took the time to properly assess him, relieve his pain, investigate what was happening and explain everything to us clearly. They have an impressive range of equipment and diagnostics available on site, including ultrasound, X-rays, blood tests and urine testing, which makes a huge difference when dealing with something that can become serious very quickly.

A few days later, we became concerned again because we thought he wasn’t urinating properly. We called the clinic and, once again, they immediately understood the urgency and told us to bring him in straight away. They checked him, made sure he received the care he needed, and took the situation seriously from the very beginning.

But what impressed me most isn’t even the equipment or the medical facilities. It is the people.

From the reception team to the veterinarians and the chief veterinarian, everyone we have dealt with has been incredibly professional, attentive and genuinely caring. Whenever you call, they don’t just hear you. They actually listen. They take the information seriously, ask the right questions, explain the situation and provide clear solutions and guidance.

I have previously taken my cat to two other veterinary clinics in Amsterdam, and honestly, I have not experienced even 20% of this level of service, communication and care.

You can have the best equipment in the world, but what really matters is having people who understand when something is urgent, who care about the animal, and who make you feel that your concerns are being taken seriously. Stadiondierenkliniek does exactly that.

Clinics with this combination of professionalism, expertise, communication and genuine compassion are rare.

I highly recommend Stadiondierenkliniek. They have absolutely earned every one of these five stars. ❤️🐾
Really great professionals. Highly recommend. Very happy with the treatment of our cat.

My cat was helped quickly and pleasantly.
Great clinic!

The staff are very nice and kind, they truly care.
I take my dog Rave and my 2 cats often there, i highly recommend the clinic ❤️
We came here for our fig tapeworm treatment before returning to the uk. Amazing staff and very affordable in comparison to the uk

In 2021, I took my 9-year-old Chihuahua to them to have blood drawn and her kidneys flushed; it cost me 1,000 euros plus 500 euros for the euthanasia. Then, on April 8, 2026, I had a 3-year-old puppy. I said I thought she might have epilepsy. I paid 300 euros for a blood test, and then she told me it was due to her teeth. I didn't receive a medical record from her because she said I still had to pay 16 euros, so the conclusion is that she let a puppy die for 16 euros. I went to the veterinary hospital on June 12, and there it turned out my suspicion was correct, but something serious, because she had a brain tumor. So, another wrong diagnosis for two of my dogs.
Good, kind vet and assistants...have a heart for animals...💚 …

Very kind, caring staff and the veterinarian lady is very supportive and caring as well! I called many clinics asking for an appointment within the week and everyone rejected. But with her, she asked for the reason, understood that I needed immediate help and showed some flexibility which is really find to hard. I am grateful to Dr. Evelyn.

Nothing but praise for Stadionplein Veterinary Clinic. My extremely difficult dog is received and treated there with love. They are there for both people and animals and are always friendly. Good care in a welcoming environment. I had a little dog (Toby) put to sleep there a few months ago. It was done with so much love. You are given all the time you need to say goodbye to your pet in a pleasant way. And the prices are perfectly fine too. I recommend this clinic with all my heart. We spread the word to each other in my apartment building and everyone is full of praise.

Absolutely lovely staff. Amazing communication. Easy to book an appointment via email. Great english- super helpful as I sadly don’t speak Dutch! Very good with animals, were lovely with my puppy. Highly recommend !!!

Upd: cat names Shimmy and Marvin. The problem for one of them can't be “resolved” anymore 😢 I have supported my friend in visits, its OK you don't remember my face

Deeply disappointed and heartbroken by the care (or lack thereof) at this clinic. Two serious misdiagnoses that had devastating consequences for our pets.

First case: after our cat fell and injured himself, the vet diagnosed it as a simple tooth inflammation. The actual problem was a fractured jaw, which led to an infection that went untreated. Because of this missed diagnosis, we ended up at another clinic where they now need to remove 9 teeth — damage that could have been prevented if the fracture had been identified and treated correctly from the start.

Second case: a misdiagnosis of our other cat ultimately led to her death. I will never forgive this.

I understand that medicine is not always straightforward, but two such serious errors — with consequences this severe — are unacceptable. I strongly advise anyone to seek a second opinion before trusting any diagnosis from this clinic. We trusted them with the lives of our animals. That trust was catastrophically misplaced.

Hi
The reception ladies are so helpful and nice , the attitude is great
I think there is many false references here about the attitude
Thanks

€170 for a castration is just not right. And then you call me back all snarky to lecture me when I have a valid opinion about this? Don't you have enough Gucci bags or something?
I have five Maine Coons, and the care here used to be excellent (although the practice is messy and dirty, and your assistants aren't always very knowledgeable), but I won't tolerate this shameless greed (which you previously pretended to find shameful as well) from anyone. Besides, you're not very bright anyway if you chase away a client with five cats. Not to mention the fiddling (tampering) with the Stadspas bill.
I've now spoken to four other clinics where castration (a short and simple procedure) is performed for less than €100.
Apparently, care and a heart for animals are no longer a priority here. This clinic has visibly deteriorated since Claire left; you should be ashamed of yourself.
I just returned from a trip to Turkey, where I fed fresh hearts to hundreds of stray cats every day. For €170, I could have neutered ten of them or paid for other medical care. I'm certainly not going to spend that on some upstart... who lies with a straight face that this price is normal.
Bye.
Excellent clinic! Amazing and gentle approach to pets and their owners 🩷 …

5 stars says it all!
Very friendly and professional treatment.
No better veterinary practice for our cat Pippie!
I had a difficult situation with my cat, and they were incredibly helpful in helping me figure out how to resolve it and acted very quickly. Thank you, thank you, thank you!!!

Always great advice, super sweet people, and nothing is too much to ask.
They're incredibly kind to your pet and leave you feeling great.
10/10!

Last Monday, we had our very sick tomcat examined at Stadionkliniek after multiple extremely expensive and pointless visits to an emergency clinic. Within half an hour, we received a clear diagnosis and helpful medication. We are enormously grateful to the team at Stadionkliniek!
Nothing but praise for Stadion Dierenkliniek. I know my little man, Hello Kitty, is in good hands here.

We are so happy that we ended up here, felt heard and not just a number, the whole team is super sweet, even when our beagle passed away in a family setting with burning candles, there was plenty of time and understanding, we are never going anywhere else again 🐕🐄🐩❣️ …
Even 1 star is too much for this "practice" - completely unprofessional!

What an amazing Team!!!

They stand up for the animal, with a great deal of knowledge but above all with love..

Our terminally ill cat is being treated with respect and love, and the best possible option is being considered without self-interest.
And CERTAINLY no unnecessary or pointless treatments are being performed.
It is precisely because of this lovely Team that my cat can stay with us a little longer WITH quality and comfort, and when the moment comes to say goodbye... even then, the Team will be there for us with honor and integrity.
They are there for both people and animals.
If people ask me if I know a good vet... then I will certainly recommend this Team ....Carl

I loved this place. They are really efficient, warm, with the owners and of course the pets. I was going through a hard time because of personal stuff and they were really caring and nice. I will definetely come back to this veterinary when in Amsterdam! You can tell they love animals.

Most caring veterinarian clinic. During the most difficult time in my life they helped me navigate through options and decisions to care for my 17-year old cat. They are available, professionally decisive but also very personable in their approach. I only wish I had known them sooner. We will be back to continue loving his remaining sister.
Top vet with an amazing team; my cat has been given a second chance at life, whereas the previous vet had already given up for dead!
Received good help, a bit pricey, good service, fast and knowledgeable
Such a great vet! Never have I had a vet so caring!
Helped quickly and professionally. Good advice, friendly staff.
Thank you for all your support for Miika💖 …

I have been coming here unfortunately a lot for 4 years. I came here first because my poodle was diagnosed with a cyst formed from fat tissue, I was told not to worry about it after 2 exams including a biopt. I went to this vet and he did not trust it depsite the biopt and it turned out to be plaveiselcelcarcionoma. Ever since I switched to this vet and he has helped with all problems adequately. You can tell Hank is very eager to get to the bottom of things and is still very fascinated by his profession, he knows a lot about healthcare for pets that is usually treated by specialist clinics. The surgeries he has done on my pets were of high quality and very effective, also he avoids anesthesia when it’s not necessary and always choses the approach which causes the lesst dtress to the animal he treats. The office can get quite busy but everyone is very welcoming and loving towards the animals. This is one of the few small practices which isn’t owned by major investment companies like evidensia so the pricing is also reasonable. That all said I must point out that the strength in this practice is Hank, I have had less successful experiences with his replacement Claire, the new girl that is being trained also is exciting to learn and caring so I have high hopes for her as well. Currently going through some though times with a new puppy with weird  symptoms and I fully trust this team with their ability to handle this situation.

Great and helpful staff with a nice small veterinary office. They helped my dog when ever he needed something quickly and with smile on their face.
Thank you

I never really write reviews, but this one was absolutely amazing. Always long wait times (last time 30 minutes), even though I made an appointment. I went in for a standard vaccination. My pet (cat) panicked, and the assistant scolded me with the clippers. Not very animal-friendly. Afterward, I was sprayed with sedatives and had to take the cat home covered in its own vomit and feces. I will never go here again.
